references.text: The description of the tabernacle (mishkan) and its coverings that the sons of Gershon were responsible to guard.
The representation of the tabernacle and its curtains corresponding to what the sons of Gershon were to oversee.
The screen (masak) at the entrance to the tent for which the sons of Gershon were responsible.
Moses sets up the tabernacle with its covering, which was under the responsibility of the sons of Gershon.
A detailed description of the service of the Gershonites regarding the tabernacle's curtains, coverings, and screen.
Moses gives carts and oxen to the sons of Gershon for their service with the tabernacle.
